errors.evidence: The figure image does not have a title. The text "Token Ratio (TR)" is the caption for the figure in the source paper, not a title printed on the chart image.
The model name in the legend is "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", not "Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0". The capitalization is incorrect.

errors.text_span: In most categories, the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model achieves a token ratio of 1.00
errors.evidence: The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 model achieves a token ratio of 1.00 in all six categories shown, not just "most" categories.
